checked_claims.details: Checked standard 2–4-player scope, all named components and starting-deck counts; Streamlined, solo, teams and cross-product rules are excluded; 20 standard versus 10 contrasting-back compatibility contracts are distinguished.

Conflict construction, leader choice, objectives/first player, decks/row/reserve, starting VP by player count, four track cubes, three garrison troops, nine supply troops, Agents, Spies, water, bank and unlimited bank resources agree.

Checked phase order, optional early Reveal, legal normal/Spy Agent access, immediate entry payment and eligibility, Plot timing, legal pre-entry Plot resources, and Rival continuation after human Reveals.
Board/card/faction effects order, single automatic faction advance, revealed-only effects, acquisition interleaving, strength timing and cleanup destinations agree.

Checked first-player clockwise Combat Intrigue opportunities, consecutive passing, positive-strength requirement, ordinary paid ranks for three-or-fewer versus four players, winner/card ownership and cleanup.

Troop=2, sandworm=3, swords=1, no-unit zero strength, marker handling, supply recruitment, Combat flags, all newly recruited units plus two old garrison units, direct sandworm deployment and post-Combat destinations agree.

Maker Hooks are effect-specific requirements and retained; Unexpected Allies example justifies no universal Hooks condition; Shield Wall protection and optional permanent destruction are preserved. Doubling includes optional cost rewards but excludes control and battle icons.

Mandatory face-up pair match, Objective eligibility, wild Endgame icon, 10+ or deck-empty trigger, Endgame Intrigues and all five ordered tiebreakers are covered; acquire VP retention and scores beyond 12 are present.

Acquisition origins, costs, row refill, discard placement, reshuffle, no saved Persuasion, acquire effects, trash origins/destinations/optionality, ordinary discard origin, Intrigue reshuffle, and draws during/after Reveal agree.

Reach-2 VP reversal, reach-4 retained/repeatable bonus, Alliance ownership VP and transfers/loss, named access thresholds, choice of one faction for gain-two, Alliance requirements and relevant leader clarifications agree.

Placement/recall optionality, empty-post and supply origins, fallback recall, specified-post restrictions, Infiltrate/Gather Intelligence distinction and immediate timing, separate Spies for separate effects, and Spy Agent access without recall agree.

Arrakeen/Refinery control Solari and Basin control spice are separate visitor/controller benefits, including same player. Control replacement, defensive supply troop and protected Conflict locations agree.
Mandatory effects/exceptions, optional arrow costs and once limit, Steal Intrigue threshold, Fremen Bond, Recall other Agent, retreat-to-garrison, and printed-leader referral agree.

independence_statement: Fresh independent audit of only the exact frozen summary-snapshot.md identified by SHA-256 above against the supplied complete authoritative sources and necessary unannotated source graphics. I did not read any other summary version, earlier audit/reviewer conclusions, repair history, coverage questions/key, reader answers or grades; did not communicate with readers; did not assume PASS; and did not edit the summary. Verdict follows independent claim and omission checks.
limitations: Printed cards and Leaders remain authoritative for their own text. Card details absent from the authorized text/PDF sources were not invented. This audit assesses rule accuracy and material coverage within the stated scope, not historical verification metadata or excluded variants.
